# GENERATED by tools/gen_home_systems.py — do not hand-edit; regenerate.
#
# A real home system for every STG prescripted empire that has one, converted
# from STNH's own — their identity, vanilla's mechanics, as everywhere in this
# conversion. STNH's init_effect scripting is dropped wholesale — it sets STNH country
# flags and event targets we do not vendor — and its Trek planet and star
# classes are mapped onto vanilla's. Every class emitted here is checked to
# resolve before this file is written: an unmapped one crashes the game at
# startup and logs nothing (.docs/decisions/24-home-system-classes.md).
# See .docs/decisions/23-real-home-systems.md.
#
# The Federation is not here: it uses vanilla's own sol_system_initializer,
# which Real Space rescales, and which is already the real solar system. That
# also means the Federation has no AI copy — the block below is what creates one
# and there is nowhere to put it (.docs/decisions/86-static-galaxy-scenario.md).
#
# EACH CAPITAL CARRIES A GUARDED create_country. It creates this empire's AI
# copy, and only when no country already carries the empire's own design key as
# a country flag — which the player's copy does, from
# common/prescripted_flags/. That is the mechanism a Trek galaxy runs on; the
# prescripted pool is the player's roster and places nobody
# (.docs/decisions/85-create-country-initializers.md).
#
# 36 systems generated, 62 empires left on generated systems.

	planet = { name = "STG_N_BolarusVII" class = "pc_frozen" orbit_distance = 30 orbit_angle = 75 size = 11 has_ring = no }
	planet = { name = "STG_N_BolarusVIII" class = "pc_barren_cold" orbit_distance = 25 orbit_angle = 140 size = 10 has_ring = no }
	planet = {
		name = "STG_planet_name_bolian"
		class = "pc_ocean"
		orbit_distance = 22
		orbit_angle = 145
		size = 18
		starting_planet = yes
		has_ring = no
		deposit_blockers = none
		modifiers = none
		init_effect = { prevent_anomaly = yes }
		init_effect = { generate_empire_home_planet = yes }

			# The AI copy of stg_bolian_union, created only when no country is
			# already playing it. See ai_empire_block in the generator.

				limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = stg_bolian_union } } }

					name = "STG_species_name_bolian"

						trait = "trait_sedentary"
						ideal_planet_class = "pc_ocean"
					}
					effect = { save_event_target_as = bolian_union_species }
				}
				create_country = {
					name = "STG_EMPIRE_bolian"
					adjective = "STG_adjective_bolian"
					type = default
					authority = "auth_democratic"

		orbit_angle = 157
		size = 10
		has_ring = no
	}
	planet = {
		name = "Cheron Prime"
		class = "pc_arctic"
		orbit_angle = 185
		size = 18
		has_ring = no
		starting_planet = yes
		deposit_blockers = none
		modifiers = none
		init_effect = { prevent_anomaly = yes }
		init_effect = { generate_empire_home_planet = yes }
		init_effect = {
			# The AI copy of stg_minor_cheronite_nation, created only when no country is
			# already playing it. See ai_empire_block in the generator.
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = stg_minor_cheronite_nation } } }
				create_species = {
					name = "STG_species_name_minor_cheronite_nation"
					plural = "STG_species_plural_minor_cheronite_nation"
					adjective = "STG_species_adjective_minor_cheronite_nation"
					class = CHER
					portrait = "cheronite"
					homeworld = THIS
					namelist = "STG_CHERONITE"
					traits = {
						trait = "trait_organic"
						trait = "trait_industrious"
						trait = "trait_deviants"
						trait = "trait_traditional"
						ideal_planet_class = "pc_arctic"
					}
					effect = { save_event_target_as = minor_cheronite_nation_species }
				}
				create_country = {
					name = "STG_EMPIRE_minor_cheronite_nation"
					adjective = "STG_adjective_minor_cheronite_nation"
					type = default
					authority = "auth_imperial"
					civics = { civic = "civic_crowdsourcing" civic = "civic_philosopher_king" }
					ethos = { ethic = "ethic_authoritarian" ethic = "ethic_xenophobe" ethic = "ethic_spiritualist" }
					origin = "origin_default"
					species = event_target:minor_cheronite_nation_species
					name_list = "STG_CHERONITE"
					ship_prefix = "STG_ship_prefix_minor_cheronite_nation"
					flag = {
						icon = { category = "pirate" file = "flag_pirate_4.dds" }
						background = { category = "backgrounds" file = "00_solid.dds" }
						colors = { "grey" "dark_blue" "null" "null" }
					}
					effect = {
						save_event_target_as = minor_cheronite_nation_country
						set_graphical_culture = generic_01
						set_city_graphical_culture = humanoid_01
						set_country_flag = stg_minor_cheronite_nation
					}
				}
				create_colony = { owner = event_target:minor_cheronite_nation_country }
				generate_start_deposits_and_blockers = yes
				clear_blockers = yes
				colony = {
					generate_start_buildings_and_districts = yes
					generate_start_pops = yes
				}
				event_target:minor_cheronite_nation_country = {
					create_starting_leaders = yes
					country_event = { id = game_start.9 }
					country_event = { id = game_start.33 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	planet = {
		name = "Cheron V"
		class = "pc_gas_giant"
		orbit_angle = 157
		size = 27
		has_ring = yes
	}
}

		name = "Haakon"

		orbit_angle = 157
		size = 23
		has_ring = no

		deposit_blockers = none
		modifiers = none
		init_effect = { prevent_anomaly = yes }
		init_effect = { generate_empire_home_planet = yes }
		init_effect = {
			# The AI copy of stg_minor_haakonian_order, created only when no country is
			# already playing it. See ai_empire_block in the generator.
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = stg_minor_haakonian_order } } }
				create_species = {
					name = "STG_species_name_minor_haakonian_order"
					plural = "STG_species_plural_minor_haakonian_order"
					adjective = "STG_species_adjective_minor_haakonian_order"

						trait = "trait_organic"
						trait = "trait_strong"
						trait = "trait_resilient"
						ideal_planet_class = "pc_arctic"
					}
					effect = { save_event_target_as = minor_haakonian_order_species }
				}
				create_country = {
					name = "STG_EMPIRE_minor_haakonian_order"
					adjective = "STG_adjective_minor_haakonian_order"
					type = default

					origin = "origin_default"
					species = event_target:minor_haakonian_order_species
					name_list = "STG_HAAKONIAN"
					ship_prefix = "STG_ship_prefix_minor_haakonian_order"
					flag = {
						icon = { category = "trek" file = "haakonian.dds" }
						background = { category = "backgrounds" file = "00_solid.dds" }
						colors = { "dark_teal" "burgundy" "null" "null" }
					}
					effect = {
						save_event_target_as = minor_haakonian_order_country
						set_graphical_culture = generic_01
						set_city_graphical_culture = humanoid_01
						set_country_flag = stg_minor_haakonian_order
					}
				}
				create_colony = { owner = event_target:minor_haakonian_order_country }

		orbit_angle = 157
		size = 8
		has_ring = no
	}
	planet = {
		name = "Krayus II"

		orbit_angle = 157

	}
	planet = {
		name = "Krayus III"

		orbit_angle = 157
		size = 8
		has_ring = no
	}
	planet = {
		name = "Krayus IV"
		class = "pc_toxic"
		orbit_angle = 157
		size = 8
		has_ring = no
	}
	planet = {
		name = "Kraylora"
		class = "pc_continental"
		orbit_angle = 157
		size = 18
		has_ring = no
		starting_planet = yes
		deposit_blockers = none
		modifiers = none
		init_effect = { prevent_anomaly = yes }
		init_effect = { generate_empire_home_planet = yes }
		init_effect = {
			# The AI copy of stg_minor_kraylor_republic, created only when no country is
			# already playing it. See ai_empire_block in the generator.
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = stg_minor_kraylor_republic } } }
				create_species = {
					name = "STG_species_name_minor_kraylor_republic"
					plural = "STG_species_plural_minor_kraylor_republic"
					adjective = "STG_species_adjective_minor_kraylor_republic"
					class = KRA
					portrait = "kraylor"
					homeworld = THIS
					namelist = "STG_KRAYLOR"
					traits = {
						trait = "trait_organic"
						trait = "trait_agrarian"
						ideal_planet_class = "pc_continental"
					}
					effect = { save_event_target_as = minor_kraylor_republic_species }
				}
				create_country = {
					name = "STG_EMPIRE_minor_kraylor_republic"
					adjective = "STG_adjective_minor_kraylor_republic"
					type = default
					authority = "auth_democratic"
					civics = { civic = "civic_technocracy" civic = "civic_free_haven" }
					ethos = { ethic = "ethic_xenophile" ethic = "ethic_pacifist" ethic = "ethic_materialist" }
					origin = "origin_default"
					species = event_target:minor_kraylor_republic_species
					name_list = "STG_KRAYLOR"
					ship_prefix = "STG_ship_prefix_minor_kraylor_republic"
					flag = {
						icon = { category = "ornate" file = "flag_ornate_9.dds" }
						background = { category = "backgrounds" file = "00_solid.dds" }
						colors = { "dark_brown" "dark_blue" "null" "null" }
					}
					effect = {
						save_event_target_as = minor_kraylor_republic_country
						set_graphical_culture = malon
						set_city_graphical_culture = humanoid_01
						set_country_flag = stg_minor_kraylor_republic
					}
				}
				create_colony = { owner = event_target:minor_kraylor_republic_country }
				generate_start_deposits_and_blockers = yes
				clear_blockers = yes
				colony = {
					generate_start_buildings_and_districts = yes
					generate_start_pops = yes
				}
				event_target:minor_kraylor_republic_country = {
					create_starting_leaders = yes
					country_event = { id = game_start.9 }
					country_event = { id = game_start.33 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

# stg_suliban_empire — from STNH's suliban_homeworld. Geometry theirs, mechanics vanilla's.
stg_suliban_empire_home = {
	name = "STG_system_name_suliban"
	class = "sc_g"
	usage = custom_empire
	flags = { empire_home_system stg_home_system }
	init_effect = { generate_home_system_resources = yes }

	asteroid_belt = { type = rocky_asteroid_belt radius = 230 }
	planet = {
		name = "Exile"
		class = star
		orbit_distance = 0
		orbit_angle = 1
		size = 30
		has_ring = no
	}
	planet = {
		name = "Haven"
		class = "pc_gas_giant"
		orbit_distance = 200
		orbit_angle = 60
		size = 35
		has_ring = yes
		moon = {
			name = "Helix 01"
			class = "pc_machine"
			orbit_distance = 10
			orbit_angle = 160
			size = 12
			has_ring = no
			starting_planet = yes
			deposit_blockers = none
			modifiers = none
			init_effect = { prevent_anomaly = yes }
			init_effect = { generate_empire_home_planet = yes }
			init_effect = {
				# The AI copy of stg_suliban_empire, created only when no country is
				# already playing it. See ai_empire_block in the generator.
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = stg_suliban_empire } } }
					create_species = {
						name = "STG_species_name_suliban"
						plural = "STG_species_plural_suliban"
						adjective = "STG_species_adjective_suliban"
						class = SUL
						portrait = "suliban"
						homeworld = THIS
						namelist = "STG_SULIBAN"
						traits = {
							trait = "trait_organic"
							trait = "trait_talented"
							trait = "trait_quick_learners"
							ideal_planet_class = "pc_desert"
						}
						effect = { save_event_target_as = suliban_empire_species }
					}
					create_country = {
						name = "STG_EMPIRE_suliban"
						adjective = "STG_adjective_suliban"
						type = default
						authority = "auth_dictatorial"
						civics = { civic = "civic_corvee_system" civic = "civic_cutthroat_politics" }
						ethos = { ethic = "ethic_fanatic_authoritarian" ethic = "ethic_xenophobe" }
						origin = "origin_default"
						species = event_target:suliban_empire_species
						name_list = "STG_SULIBAN"
						ship_prefix = "STG_ship_prefix_suliban"
						flag = {
							icon = { category = "trek" file = "suliban.dds" }
							background = { category = "backgrounds" file = "00_solid.dds" }
							colors = { "dark_green" "grey" "null" "null" }
						}
						effect = {
							save_event_target_as = suliban_empire_country
							set_graphical_culture = suliban
							set_city_graphical_culture = humanoid_01
							set_country_flag = stg_suliban_empire
						}
					}
					create_colony = { owner = event_target:suliban_empire_country }
					generate_start_deposits_and_blockers = yes
					clear_blockers = yes
					colony = {
						generate_start_buildings_and_districts = yes
						generate_start_pops = yes
					}
					event_target:suliban_empire_country = {
						create_starting_leaders = yes
						country_event = { id = game_start.9 }
						country_event = { id = game_start.33 days = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					generate_start_pops = yes
				}
				event_target:xindi_empire_country = {
					create_starting_leaders = yes
					country_event = { id = game_start.9 }
					country_event = { id = game_start.33 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# stg_yridian_empire — authored: STNH's own home system is procedural.
stg_yridian_empire_home = {
	name = "STG_system_name_yridian"
	class = "sc_k"

	planet = { name = "STG_system_name_yridian" class = "pc_k_star" orbit_distance = 0 orbit_angle = 1 size = 24 has_ring = no }
	planet = { name = "STG_N_YridiaI" class = "pc_molten" orbit_distance = 38 orbit_angle = 60 size = 8 has_ring = no }
	planet = {
		name = "STG_planet_name_yridian"
		class = "pc_arid"
		orbit_distance = 22
		orbit_angle = 145
		size = 18
		starting_planet = yes
		has_ring = no
		deposit_blockers = none
		modifiers = none
		init_effect = { prevent_anomaly = yes }
		init_effect = { generate_empire_home_planet = yes }
		init_effect = {
			# The AI copy of stg_yridian_empire, created only when no country is
			# already playing it. See ai_empire_block in the generator.
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = stg_yridian_empire } } }
				create_species = {
					name = "STG_species_name_yridian"
					plural = "STG_species_plural_yridian"
					adjective = "STG_species_adjective_yridian"
					class = YRI
					portrait = "yridian"
					homeworld = THIS
					namelist = "STG_YRIDIAN"
					traits = {
						trait = "trait_organic"
						trait = "trait_thrifty"
						trait = "trait_talented"
						trait = "trait_traditional"
						trait = "trait_repugnant"
						ideal_planet_class = "pc_arid"
					}
					effect = { save_event_target_as = yridian_empire_species }
				}
				create_country = {
					name = "STG_EMPIRE_yridian"
					adjective = "STG_adjective_yridian"
					type = default
					authority = "auth_corporate"
					civics = { civic = "civic_brand_loyalty" civic = "civic_media_conglomerate" }
					ethos = { ethic = "ethic_authoritarian" ethic = "ethic_xenophile" ethic = "ethic_materialist" }
					origin = "origin_default"
					species = event_target:yridian_empire_species
					name_list = "STG_YRIDIAN"
					ship_prefix = "STG_ship_prefix_yridian"
					flag = {
						icon = { category = "trek" file = "yridian.dds" }
						background = { category = "backgrounds" file = "00_solid.dds" }
						colors = { "dark_brown" "yellow" "null" "null" }
					}
					effect = {
						save_event_target_as = yridian_empire_country
						set_graphical_culture = yridian
						set_city_graphical_culture = humanoid_01
						set_country_flag = stg_yridian_empire
					}
				}
				create_colony = { owner = event_target:yridian_empire_country }
				generate_start_deposits_and_blockers = yes
				clear_blockers = yes
				colony = {
					generate_start_buildings_and_districts = yes
					generate_start_pops = yes
				}
				event_target:yridian_empire_country = {
					create_starting_leaders = yes
					country_event = { id = game_start.9 }
					country_event = { id = game_start.33 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	planet = { name = "STG_N_YridiaIII" class = "pc_barren" orbit_distance = 28 orbit_angle = 200 size = 11 has_ring = no }
	planet = { name = "STG_N_YridiaIV" class = "pc_gas_giant" orbit_distance = 55 orbit_angle = 290 size = 25 has_ring = yes }
	usage = custom_empire
	flags = { empire_home_system stg_home_system }
	init_effect = { generate_home_system_resources = yes }
}
